title: Spellforge Mouse
description: A pale, emaciated anthropomorphic mouse with long flowing brown hair and a flower crown kneels on cracked asphalt, blood dripping from its mouth while manipulating a small wooden contraption that emits sparks and glowing orange threads. In the background, a dramatic blood-red sunset looms over a dark city skyline as a multi-lane highway stretches into the distance with cars and tiny human figures.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene of a thin white anthropomorphic mouse creature kneeling on a cracked highway at sunset. The mouse has long flowing brown hair adorned with white flowers, blood running from its mouth, and is working on a small wooden mechanical device that sparks and emits glowing orange threads. Dramatic blood-red sun behind a dark city skyline, cars on the road, tiny human silhouettes, black curtains dripping in the sky, ominous and macabre atmosphere, detailed painting style
